_comment: IMEX activation destinations specified for this kiosk: Andalucía, Madrid, Cataluña, País Vasco, Galicia, Valencia. Costume/scene lines feed /api/banana. Rename here if the client adjusts wording.

destinations.label: Andalucía
destinations.costumePrompt: Tasteful Andalusian festival dress: embroidered short jacket or modest flamenca-inspired look (high neckline, full skirt, never sexualized), sash, Córdoba-style wide-brim hat optional. Smart travel alternative: linen and polished leather, still clearly Andalusian feria energy. NO baseball jerseys, NO sports uniforms.
destinations.scenePrompt: Composite of Seville's Plaza de España arcades and Giralda tower at fiery golden-hour sunset, palm silhouettes, warm stone, cinematic travel-poster depth. Landmark reads as Andalucía, not a generic plaza.

destinations.label: Madrid

destinations.scenePrompt: Composite of Madrid's Palacio Real and Gran Vía dusk glow, grand boulevards, warm street lamps, cinematic skyline. Landmark reads as Madrid.
